entities.summary: Chartchai Chionoi a.k.a. Chartchai Laemfapha or birth name Naris Chionoi was a Thai professional boxer, WBC world champion and WBA world champion in the flyweight division. He took the WBC World Flyweight Championship two successive times and the WBA Championship one time before finally relinquishing it.
